title: Understanding Feature Selection
text: When you want to reduce the number of features in a model, consider methods that can automatically set some coefficients to zero. This helps in identifying and removing unimportant features.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Regularization techniques like LASSO and Ridge are used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. LASSO, in particular, can shrink some coefficients to zero.

hintAnswer: Use LASSO regression to predict Y from X.
title: Choosing the Right Regression
text: Which regression technique is known for setting some feature weights to zero, thus helping in feature selection?
